faction.aom-atlantean.aomAtlantean.descr:
{Atlantis}
Alignment: Neutral, Lawful
Native Terrain: Coastal Land
Location: Enroth - the Atlantis Isles in the Western Ocean
Atlantis is the kingdom of the ten kings in the ocean west of Enroth, its capital Poseidonia ringed by three canals. The Atlanteans once revered the god of the sea; later they turned their backs on the Olympians to serve the three Titans Kronos, Oranos and Gaia, and with divine power and ingenuity they command automatons and creatures of myth. After the home island sank beneath the sea, the survivors rebuilt their ring-shaped cities on many shores, where they await the return of the Titans.
